pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take: **This isn't a fantasy pool; it's a clown show, and "The Noisemaker" is the ringleader.** Rafe, do you even watch the sport or just randomly pick teams by letting a FIFA video game choose for you? Your choices scream ignorance, with three teams that didn't even qualify. No wonder you're dragging behind in last place with a pathetic 29 points. Gayden, aka "The Backpass Assassin," your World Cup strategy must be stuck in reverse because you're barely above Rafe with 39 points — it's as if you think Japan and Ivory Coast are secretly world beaters. Devin, "Ghost Pepper," I'll give you credit for an attempt, having Spain carry you, but you're still trailing Gunner by a massive margin. But it's "Bubba G," Gunner, that shows even a blind squirrel can sometimes find a nut. With 81 points, it's like he stumbled into competence — probably by luck rather than skill. And Zach, "Mustard Boy," you're as tasteless as they come, sitting in the mediocre middle at 43 points with Switzerland and Austria pulling you down faster than a lead balloon. Gunner's the only one remotely sniffing success, whereas the rest of you are just hobbyists at best.
